references.text: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary are mentioned again as witnesses to Jesus' burial.
Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of James, are mentioned as those who observed where Jesus was laid.
Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, observe Jesus' burial.
Mary Magdalene is mentioned as one of the women who followed Jesus and served him.
Mary Magdalene is mentioned among the women who reported Jesus' resurrection to the apostles.
